description: While reducing fz-bin.17, a local make/3 returning {:ok, n, fn -> ...} and then calling the closure after dbg(n) exposed a separate native direct-call fast-path bug. After entry-capture encoding correctly treats the closure as boxed/published, the direct closure call still selects the local target and passes structural capture lanes plus call args, producing a verifier mismatch such as main__e0__resume_2 got 6 args for a target signature expecting 3. Range enumerable no longer depends on this path because the protocol slicer uses the published callable boundary, but the direct fast path should skip boxed/published callable values or rematerialize through the settled boundary before direct target invocation.
title: Direct fast path miscalls boxed tuple-returned closure after resume
